preventive_first.title: A soft prevention step
preventive_first.body: Choose one easy habit that lowers overload this week — an earlier wind-down, a water reminder, or a short daily walk.

physiological_first.title: Protect your basics
physiological_first.body: Keep a steady sleep window and add one recovery practice before raising intensity or adding new goals.

behavioral_first.title: Make the habit easy
behavioral_first.body: Pick a clear cue and a 10-minute starter routine so the habit can survive busy days.

lifestyle.title: A kinder daily rhythm
lifestyle.body: Align meals, daylight, and movement with the hours you already feel most steady.

risk_awareness.title: A calm check-in
risk_awareness.body: Note any new or worsening symptoms and bring them to a clinician if they persist; use Health Guide for educational framing only.

performance.title: Balance effort and recovery
performance.body: Match training or deep-work blocks with equal recovery so progress stays kind and sustainable.

questionnaire.title: Keep your answers current
questionnaire.body: Your questionnaire is {{percent}}% complete. Update sections when life changes so future reports stay accurate and helpful.

service.title: Continue with {{service}}
service.body: Return to the {{service}} workspace after trying one recommendation and note what felt better.

devices.title: Optional device layer
devices.body: Link a wearable when you are ready so trends can gently complement your questionnaire context.

devicesActive.title: Glance at device trends
devicesActive.body: Skim the last week from your {{count}} linked device(s) and note one pattern that matches how you felt.
